business_summary: OMH SCIENCE Group Co., Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sales of intelligent production systems, intelligent logistics storage systems, intelligent parking systems, and spare parts in China and internationally. The company offers intelligent manufacturing system EPC, intelligent production solution; intelligent warehousing solutions; intelligent distribution solution; intelligent sorting solutions; and intelligent 3D parking solutions. It also provides stackers, hoist, forklift and stacking AGV, cross belt sorter, conveyor, intelligent stereo garage, and parking robot; and OMH cloud platform, OMH SCMP, modularization management, WMS, WMC, and monitoring system. In addition, the company offers services, such as planning consultation, software system research and development, intelligent equipment design and manufacturing, system integration, installation and implementation, and after-sales maintenance. It serves automobiles, new energy, cold chain, wine, pharmaceutical, e-commerce, FMCG, home, 3C electronics, steel, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Shanxi Oriental Material Handling Co., Ltd. and changed its name to OMH SCIENCE Group Co., Ltd in June 2020. OMH SCIENCE Group Co., Ltd was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Taiyuan, China.
